description: The plot titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain” illustrates how three evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, and F1-score) vary across different model variants. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” on a categorical (non-numeric) scale with five categories: “Full Model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly from 58 to 66 with regularly spaced tick marks at 58, 60, 62, 64, and 66 (percent units). Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: the Precision line (purple) starts at 65.53 for “Full Model (Ours),” drops to 61.06 at “w/o Prompt,” rises to 61.57 at “w/o Augmentation,” increases to 64.06 at “w/o Attention,” and then rises further to a final point near the top of the axis (above 66) at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation” (the exact last value is not fully visible). The Recall line (blue) starts at 65.78, decreases to 59.64 at “w/o Prompt,” increases to 62.63 at “w/o Augmentation,” then declines to 59.17 at “w/o Attention,” and ends at 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The F1-score line (tan) begins at 65.45, drops to 60.16 at “w/o Prompt,” rises to 62.22 at “w/o Augmentation,” decreases to 59.67 at “w/o Attention,” and finishes at 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.”
